parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

parameters.name: DeliverName
parameters.description: The name of the log shipping job.

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service project.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the log shipping job.

Valid values:

*   Delete
*   Pause
*   Restart

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-log-hub-status --db-cluster-id am-uf6j8370er80m6wf3 --project-name test-adb --deliver-name loghub-mnp-report --status Pause --log-store-name pay-notify-wx --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
